summary: Verify the secret with oc get secret, created in the release's project before install or upgrade (or create it in the console as a key/value secret with key auth.json). Set redhat-developer-hub.global.pluginMode to oci or tarball; change it later with a Helm upgrade in the console or helm upgrade on the CLI.
